mapper.insert: INSERT INTO signup_sms_verification (PURPOSE, PHONE, CODE, ATTEMPTS, CREATED_AT, VERIFIED_AT) VALUES (#{purpose}, #{phone}, #{code}, #{attempts}, #{createdAt}, #{verifiedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE signup_sms_verification SET CODE = #{code}, ATTEMPTS = 0, CREATED_AT = #{createdAt}, VERIFIED_AT = NULL WHERE PURPOSE = #{purpose} AND PHONE = #{phone}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM signup_sms_verification WHERE PURPOSE = #{purpose} AND PHONE = #{phone}
DELETE FROM signup_sms_verification WHERE (VERIFIED_AT IS NULL AND CREATED_AT < #{codeCutoff}) OR (VERIFIED_AT IS NOT NULL AND VERIFIED_AT < #{verifiedCutoff})
